name: cmi-golden-exchange
purpose: Consumer-owned golden exchange projections captured from real CLI, MCP tool, and MCP resource read surfaces. Only volatile runtime identity is tokenized; evidence meaning and protected public fields remain exact.

allowed: Replace a generated Session ID with <SESSION_ID>.
Replace a generated Change ID with <CHANGE_ID> when the archetype contains one.
Replace a generated Finding ID with <FINDING_ID>.
Normalize CRLF to LF in human text.
forbidden: Do not remove or rewrite evidence provenance, confidence, verification state, scope relation, file paths, actions, or violation establishment.
Do not normalize missing fields into present fields.
Do not project timestamps or temporary filesystem paths into the golden exchange.
